task_name: Apexguard - Product label and dealer collateral system
client_brief:
Dealer-ready roll labels and bay imagery for Apexguard

Our dealer meetings need a reliable label system, not another set of labels assembled one by one. Apexguard has three tiers that should read as one family, and the current stock export must control the product information.

The commission

 Product roll label: 13 named exports. The tier is identified accurately, and each label carries the Apexguard mark. The complete warranty_statement remains inside the label trim.

 Dealer range brochure: 1 named export. The product tiers are easy to compare: for each tier it gives film gauge, clarity retained, self-healing topcoat, hydrophobic contact angle, UV rejection, finish and warranty term, and each width offered with its sku_code and dealer price. The uses are supported by the approved range data, and the brochure carries the Apexguard mark and at least one of the supplied bay photographs.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Paint protection film, window tint and ceramic coating supplied to dealer groups and to independent installers who buy film by the roll.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Charlotte, North Carolina; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Apexguard Surface Systems is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Charlotte, North Carolina, and this commission covers phase 2: dealer labels and channel collateral.
brand_identity.audience: Dealer group principals and fixed operations managers aged 35 to 55 deciding whether to put us on their reconditioning line, and independent installer owners aged 28 to 50 who buy film by the roll and post their own work. Behind both sits a vehicle owner aged 30 to 55 protecting a sixty thousand dollar car.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Full PPF installs 1,800 to 6,000 dollars, tint packages 400 to 1,200 dollars, film by the roll to installers 900 to 4,200 dollars. Premium performance tier, well above discount tint shops and deliberately not tuner.

palette.name: Graphite Black
palette.usage: All type on Titanium White (SKU, tier name, roll size, performance labels and figures, warranty, price), as on rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf, and the one dark ground or panel colour, which carries Titanium White type and the reversed mark.

palette.name: Titanium White
palette.usage: The label stock and main ground, as on rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf, and all type reversed out of Graphite Black.

palette.name: Steel Grey
palette.usage: Small section heads on Titanium White only: the SURFACE SYSTEMS line and the PERFORMANCE and WARRANTY heads, which rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf draws as 72% and 65% tints of Graphite Black. Never a ground, panel, figure or main type.

palette.name: Silver Line
palette.usage: Table row rules and dividers on Titanium White, where rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf draws its row rules as a 16% tint of Graphite Black. Never type, a ground, a panel or a figure.

palette.name: Guard Bronze
palette.role: mandatory: at least one hairline rule on every label and on the brochure, as the one bronze rule of rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf
palette.usage: Hairline rules only, at least one on each label and in the brochure: the 0.5 pt hairline under the APEXGUARD wordmark wherever the wordmark is set as type, and any other accent rule. Never type, a ground, a panel or a fill.

brand_identity.typography: Apexguard runs a four step scale on the two faces it already owns. Step 01, display and H1, is Excon Bold at 40 pt on 44 pt, Bold, tracking -10 units. Step 02, subheading and H2, is the SKU in Excon Bold at 30 pt on 33 pt, tracking 20 units, with tier names one rank down at 16 pt on 19 pt in the same face and tracking. Step 03, body, is Whitney Book at 9.5 pt on 13.5 pt, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters, with spec tables one rank down at 8 pt on 11 pt using tabular lining figures. Step 04, fine print, is Whitney Book warranty copy at 7 pt on 10 pt, tracking 15 units. The measured number carries through every step: against the 8 pt spec label the figure is Excon Bold at 24 pt, three times the label, with its unit on the same baseline at 8 pt, one third of the figure. The wordmark stands outside the scale as Excon Bold caps tracked 120 units over a 0.5 pt Guard Bronze hairline, and a figure is never italicised.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, exact, performance led. States numbers and lets them carry. Example line the brand would write: Ten year warranty, self healing topcoat, 92 percent clarity retained. No exclamation points, no percentage flashes, no hype.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The rebrand mark was drafted for us by an earlier round and no working file survives. What we hold is a flat raster export of the drafted master mark and a phone photograph of the installer shop card that was printed from an earlier revision of it. The mark has to be recovered as real artwork before the rollout can carry it, and the three tier marks brought alongside so the family reads as one.
brand_identity.values: Performance stated honestly and warranted as written. One brand across every surface, from the top of a dealer deck to the end of a film box.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every performance figure is set in Excon Bold at three times its label size with the unit locked to the same baseline at exactly one third of the figure, so value and unit read as a single measured object.

scale.note: The wordmark is the one exception above this step: Excon Bold caps tracked 120 units over a 0.5 pt Guard Bronze hairline.
SKUs sit at 30 pt; tier names run one rank down at 16 pt on 19 pt in the same face, weight and tracking.

scale.sample: Performance stated plainly, and warranted exactly as written.
scale.note: Spec tables run one rank down at 8 pt on 11 pt in Whitney Book with tabular lining figures.

scale.sample: Full warranty terms available on request.
scale.note: Warranty and legal lines. Where a spec label at 8 pt carries a measured figure, the figure is Excon Bold at 24 pt with the unit on the same baseline at 8 pt.

type_system.signature_move: Every performance figure is set in Excon Bold at three times its label size with the unit locked to the same baseline at exactly one third of the figure, so value and unit read as a single measured object. Against the 8 pt spec label that resolves to a 24 pt figure with an 8 pt unit.
rules: Every performance figure is Excon Bold at three times its label size, with the unit on the same baseline at exactly one third of the figure.
The wordmark is Excon Bold caps tracked 120 units over a 0.5 pt Guard Bronze hairline.
Spec tables and every figure in them use tabular lining figures.
No exclamation points and no percentage flashes; state the number and let it carry.
Nothing in the system reads tuner: restrained, technical, premium.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Titanium White or Graphite Black and nothing else. On Titanium White, type is Graphite Black, as on rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf, with Steel Grey only for small section heads such as PERFORMANCE, WARRANTY and the SURFACE SYSTEMS line. On Graphite Black, type is Titanium White only. Silver Line is for table rules and dividers only. Guard Bronze is the one accent and is mandatory: at least one hairline rule on every label and on the brochure, as the one bronze rule of rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf, including the 0.5 pt hairline under a typeset wordmark; hairline rules only, never type, a ground or a panel, and under 5% of the designed, non-photographic area. The Apexguard mark keeps its one supplied ink, dark on light grounds and white on Graphite Black, and is not counted as type.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph. Where rolllabel_2025_PRINT.pdf draws heads at 72% and 65% and row rules at 16% of Graphite Black, use solid Steel Grey for the heads and solid Silver Line for the rules.
palette_rules.forbidden: No chrome, bevel, foil, sheen or other metallic effect on any type, panel, rule or icon (Guard Bronze is a flat ink), no heavy gradient, starburst or percentage flash, and no colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons. The Apexguard mark prints in one flat ink, as supplied, never two-tone, gradient or metallic: dark on light grounds, white on Graphite Black. That supplied mark ink is exempt from the hex list.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never tinted, duotoned or desaturated toward Graphite Black, Steel Grey or Guard Bronze. The dark window tint in bay_frame_06.jpg still reads as tint, not plain grey glass, and the clear film edge in bay_frame_04.jpg stays clear and glossy, not a grey wash.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

assets.description: Transparent, tightly bounded Adobe-vectorized shield-and-wordmark master cleaned from the supplied artwork.
1600 px transparent raster companion for placement and preview.
White vector variant for approved dark-ground use.
